abstract: Install, serve and tune Aphrodite Engine (Sonar), the vLLM-derived inference server with OpenAI, Anthropic and Kobold APIs. References cover installation and the rename, serve flags and config, parallelism and multi-node, features (tools, speculation, quantization, LoRA, multimodal), API and security, tuning, observability, updating and troubleshooting, with a YAML config and systemd unit.
